the role of TLR10 in adipose tissue inflammation in humans and in mice.
the role of TLR10 in adipose tissue in the context of obesity.
the role of TLR10 in human adipose tissue inflammation in the context of obesity and metabolic syndrome.

TLR10 is a promising therapeutic target for the treatment of obesity‐induce inflammation.

TLR10 has a protective role in obesity‐inducible adipose tissue inflammation and that TLR10 polymorphisms in humans are associated with less adipose tissue macrophage infiltration.
